messages:
Ellen (People Ops): Quick check-in  we've published a small policy bundle today: PTO minimum formatting update, parental leave examples expanded, and a short data-classification note in the handbook. Need manager acks + team enrollments for the optional manager Q&A by EOD Wednesday. :page_with_curl:
Ravi (HRBP): To confirm: only managers need to ack the manager Q&A enrollment; all employees should see the handbook changes and the PTO formatting doesn't require e-sign, just awareness.
Tess (Eng Manager): Can you paste the CSV header for manager enrollments? I want to add my org for the Q&A slots.
Ellen (People Ops): Header below  add one row per manager + their direct reports if you're bulk enrolling: manager_email,employee_email,role,team,timezone,qa_slot_pref,ack_manager_acknowledged
Ellen (People Ops): ```manager_email,employee_email,role,team,timezone,qa_slot_pref,ack_manager_acknowledged```
Marco (SRE): Question: data-classification note does this change how we tag infra docs? Any immediate action from SRE?
Ravi (HRBP): No retro changes required. It's guidance to help teams label docs that contain PII/CONFIDENTIAL. For infra owners, please ensure runbooks referencing customer data include a classification header within two weeks. We'll follow up with a script to scan repos.
Tess (Eng Manager): For QA slots, what are the options and are there EMEA-friendly times?
Ellen (People Ops): Slots: S-A (09:00 PT), S-B (13:00 PT), S-C (19:00 PT). Put S-C for EMEA evenings. We'll localize times at import.
Marco (SRE): If someone misses the runbook relabel deadline, do we have an enforcement process?
Ravi (HRBP): We'll send a friendly reminder first, then managers will receive a weekly non-compliance digest. For critical infra runbooks we may create a Security ticket to triage.
notice-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Policy bundle: PTO+parental+data-classification" will post at T-72h and T-24h before manager ack deadline.
Tess (Eng Manager): Uploaded my CSV and marked two infra runbooks as HIGH_PRIORITY in notes column.
Ellen (People Ops): Thanks  final manager checklist: 1) bulk upload CSV, 2) ensure manager_ack set to TRUE, 3) confirm team members aware of PTO formatting change. I'll export a compliance CSV after the window: ```gsutil cp gs://redwood-ops/hr/policy_bundle_1967.csv ./policy_bundle_1967.csv```
Marco (SRE): We'll start a quick repo-scan and tag any docs that look like they contain PII.
Ravi (HRBP): If any policy wording prompts questions, label the issue "policy-question" and I'll coordinate with Legal.
Ellen (People Ops): I'll drop a short manager script and a pasteable Slack reminder in 10m. Appreciate the quick turn on this. :sparkles:
